title: What is the Ashaeiynn Mahotsav, and what are its key highlights?

segments.text: Month-Long Festival: The Ashaeiynn Mahotsav is a grand, month-long festival celebrated every year at Ashaeiynn, filled with deep spiritual practice, continuous kirtans, community bhandaras, and divine gathering.
A Sacred Tradition: The festival officially begins every year on the auspicious day of Bhadve Ki Dooj (marking the birth anniversary celebration of Baba Ramdev Pir Ji).
5th Year Milestone: 2026 marks the 5th annual milestone of this grand celebration, making this year’s Mahotsav an extra-special convergence of divine grace, devotion, and community gathering.
Uninterrupted Sacred Fire: A core highlight of the Mahotsav is the 24-hour continuous havan performed on the ashram grounds.
Led by Parikshit Bhaiya: This non-stop ritual is spearheaded and maintained by Parikshit Bhaiya alongside select Ashaeiynn members who have been granted explicit permission to perform at the altar.

Collective Sankalp & Mantra Ahuti: When Parikshit Bhaiya performs the havan, all present devotees take a collective sankalp (sacred intention) with him and offer mantra ahuti directly from their seats.
The Echo of Swaha: As Bhaiya offers samagri, ghee, and dry coconuts into the sacred fire, the devotees' "Swaha" echoes through Ashaeiynn with each offering.
